title: Sakamoto Days Manga Concludes After Six Years With Chapter 284
excerpt:
Sakamoto Days ends its six-year manga run with Chapter 284.
The anime continues, with Season 2 scheduled for January 2027.
body_md:
Yuto Suzuki's Sakamoto Days has officially concluded in Weekly Shonen Jump with Chapter 284, bringing six years of serialization to a close. The action-comedy manga follows Taro Sakamoto, a former legendary assassin whose family life and determination to leave killing behind drive much of the story. Its conclusion follows an extended final arc rather than an abrupt cancellation.

The ending comes during a period of significant turnover for Shueisha's magazine. According to the report, Sakamoto Days is the fourteenth title to finish in 2026, but only the sixth to conclude on its own narrative terms. Kenta Shinohara's Witch Watch had also ended shortly beforehand, highlighting the scale of changes to the magazine's lineup.

Spoilers for the manga finale follow. After the final confrontation with X, the penultimate chapter moves forward by roughly a year and depicts the arrival of another child in the Sakamoto family. The JAA has been dismantled, and the world of professional assassins is being reorganized around a different set of principles.

Sakamoto establishes a replacement organization that uses nonlethal methods to handle threats and maintain stability. The decision provides a thematic resolution to a story built around a feared killer trying to redefine his relationship with violence. Instead of returning to his old identity, he helps shape a world in which lethal force is no longer the default answer.

His ambition to expand the family convenience store also succeeds, with a chain of locations now operating across the region. The final chapter revisits surviving friends and former enemies, showing how their lives have moved away from the cycle of assassination. The report characterizes the ending as hopeful and comparatively complete.

The manga's conclusion does not end the franchise's screen presence. Season 2 of the anime is scheduled to arrive in January 2027, although the source does not provide an exact premiere day. Anime viewers therefore have more of Sakamoto's adventures ahead, even as readers have now reached the conclusion of the original serialized story.
